title: Tahini Chicken Fajitas
description: Spicy chicken fajitas with a nutty twist from tahini sauce, inspired by Mexican flavors.
instructions: 1. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
3. Add the fajita peppers and onions to the skillet and cook until tender.
4. In a small bowl, whisk together tahini, cumin, and lime juice.
5. Add the tahini sauce to the skillet and stir to coat the chicken and vegetables.
6. Season with salt, pepper, and fajita seasoning.
7. Serve hot with lime wedges and sour cream, if desired.
8. Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil in a small skillet over medium heat.
9. Add the fajita seasoning to the oil and cook for 1 minute.
10. Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until heated through.
